en-US.description:
I really enjoyed the BTS concert today..

I heard from friends that there was some traffic control around Gwanghwamun, and since the video I was planning to upload happened to be about things I had to give up and let go of,

I used that in the thumbnail.

I watched it on Netflix too, and their outfits were cool. Yeah... the outfits were cool, too.

I hope everything has wrapped up well by now!

I heard that Korea has benefited immensely economically thanks to BTS, who are popular stars worldwide, right?

I am also getting a lot of emotional benefits thanks to my babies.

I rambled on a bit like a complaint about the things I have to give up and let go of as a mom,

but I hope you view this as something you can relate to lightly.

What are some points you have let go of?
